status_meanings.RECOMMENDED_FOR_DESIGN: Use as a design constraint; still verify its actual implementation.

decisions.title: Release includes required runtime configuration
decisions.final_refinement: Record only required non-secret configuration beyond the repo; do not mirror the whole account.

decisions.title: Identify actual native memory before deletion
decisions.final_refinement: Trace storage, writers and copies; the name team memory is not evidence of an extra engine.

decisions.title: Canonical owners with traceable projections
decisions.final_refinement: A source can have useful scoped copies; avoid competing writable authorities.

decisions.title: Correction and concurrent memory use
decisions.final_refinement: Use native behavior first; narrow a failing write path only when evidence requires it.

decisions.title: Volatile facts and task effects are not durable-memory truth
decisions.final_refinement: Use authoritative current state and bounded recovery context rather than a second task ledger.

decisions.title: Separate instruction purpose and activation
decisions.final_refinement: Specify consumer, trigger and expected behavior before writing the final backend files.

decisions.title: Context efficiency preserves promised source coverage
decisions.final_refinement: Do not substitute file counts or snippets for a promised full content review.

decisions.title: Native coordination with complete required-result accounting
decisions.final_refinement: Final refinement: missing required worker output stays partial/failed, not all-clear.

decisions.title: Preserve skills and verify distribution/invocation
decisions.final_refinement: Copy justified working assets and dependencies; do not re-audit all business skill prose.

decisions.title: Retain justified bounded controls
decisions.final_refinement: Classify advisory, integrity and authorization roles before retaining or removing a hook.

decisions.title: Creative autonomy and external-action authority are separate
decisions.final_refinement: Final refinement: stop/recovery must cover the actual effect path, not a cosmetic setting.

decisions.title: Native routines with explicit outcomes and recovery
decisions.final_refinement: Enable consequential unattended work only after its authority, duplicates and stopping are understood.

decisions.title: External history memory only for a demonstrated gap
decisions.final_refinement: No default external engine; compare the smallest supported history/recovery solution.

decisions.title: Output offloading evaluated independently
decisions.final_refinement: MCP-only and full routing plugin are different interventions; exact evidence must survive.

decisions.title: Role-separated effort comparison
decisions.final_refinement: Pilot higher coordinator effort with ordinary workers unchanged; deep-worker effort is a separate comparison.

decisions.title: Selective reversible migration
decisions.final_refinement: Final refinement: distinguish Git state, runtime settings, memory/task state and external effects.

decisions.title: Task-specific completion evidence
decisions.final_refinement: Produced artifact, checked artifact and confirmed external effect are separate claims.

decisions.title: Progressive documentation governance
decisions.final_refinement: Mechanical checks are useful within scope; no compulsory governance spine or semantic certification.
